title: Network Activity event (connection-level telemetry for segmentation, DDoS and containment)
summary: OCSF Network Activity events the network-facing playbooks consume at connection granularity. network_security reconciles observed flows against the declared segmentation policy; ddos_response reads volumetric and connection-rate shifts to confirm an availability anomaly is an attack rather than organic load; ransomware_containment scopes lateral movement and confirms an isolated host has stopped talking. Consumed, never emitted — the framework observes flows and does not synthesise them.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Network Activity category — Network Activity class (uid 4001)
